reviews.title: Not great, but offers a convenient route
reviews.text: It's very convenient that this airline offers a direct flight between Taipei and Boracay (Caticlan) but the check-in process was terrible. It seemed as if a lot of people didn't have their documentation in order, or it took an unreasonably long time to verify each person's documents. Either way, the efficiency of the ground staff at the check-in counter should be improved, and the airline should be proactive in making sure that passengers in line have their required documents before they get to the counter. I've been in much longer lines that have moved much quicker than this one did. As for the quality of the flight experience, the aircraft interior had quite a bit of wear and tear, the legroom was not great, and there was a logo of another airline on one of the monitors. Fortunately, the flight crew was friendly and professional. Overall, I'd probably deal with the sub-optimal check-in and airplane quality to avoid Manila on a flight to Caticlan. But that says more about how horrible transiting in Manila is than it says about this airline.
